explanation: Merge of main into the staleness pass. From main: Only the expression survey runbook and project guidance wording changed, describing how the gene page shows and opens each survey source. Adding or changing a dataset, its bundles, the expression catalog entries and their checks follow the same steps and commands as before. The rename work adds one step: a dataset that changes the nomenclature table also needs pnpm run build:search-names, which regenerates the search names and the rename groups from nomenclature.tsv; project guidance states the order, the --check guard and the rule tests. From this branch: Text-only changes to usage headers and dated records, plus bundleWriter.mts taking NSIG_FDR_THRESHOLD from the shared NSIG_FDR_CUTOFF (same 0.05, so bundles are unchanged); report_september5_intake.py emits the dated header and current-audit note so regeneration keeps them. pnpm run analyze:hfd now runs scripts/analyze_hfd_r460.mts, which refuses any Rscript but R 4.6.0 and runs scripts/regen-r460/run_hfd_r460.R then run_fgsea_r460.R under LC_COLLATE=C for the stems derived from data/intake/hfd-2026-09-12/studies.json, the producers check:hfd-intake audits; it no longer runs the sealed originals, which stay byte-identical. The HFD intake record says so.
